aiScript.title: Fix Your Paper Airplane in 15 Seconds
aiScript.hook: Your paper airplanes crash in two seconds because of one massive mistake.
aiScript.narrativeArc: Hook → Problem → Solution → Benefit → Direct CTA
aiScript.soundtrackSuggestion: Phonk Beat with High-Energy Bass, 130 BPM

scenes.name: 1. The Hook
scenes.voiceover: Your paper airplanes crash in two seconds because of one massive mistake.
scenes.visualDescription: Paper airplane thrown violently across a room, nose-diving straight into the hardwood floor in super slow motion.
scenes.audioMood: High tension riser with sudden bass drop

scenes.name: 2. The Problem
scenes.voiceover: You use sharp nose folds that force all the center of mass too far forward.
scenes.visualDescription: Top-down view of hands folding a standard basic dart, overlaid with red graphic stress lines showing heavy front imbalance.

scenes.name: 3. The Solution
scenes.voiceover: Instead, fold the nose tip back one inch and crease tiny upward wing elevators.
scenes.visualDescription: Fast precision fold tucking the blunt nose inwards, followed by fingers flicking microscopic upward flaps on the trailing wing edges.
scenes.audioMood: Crisp paper swoosh and satisfying mechanical snap

scenes.name: 4. The Benefit
scenes.voiceover: This generates balanced air lift that keeps it gliding dead-straight over a hundred feet.
scenes.visualDescription: Modified glider floating effortlessly down an empty bright hallway, locked in a smooth, level laser-straight flight path.

scenes.name: 5. Call to Action
scenes.voiceover: Save this fold right now and test it before your next throw!
scenes.visualDescription: Creator catches the gliding plane mid-air with a grin, pointing directly at the save button overlay.
